messages:
Diego Santos: Hey team — first day here! Quick q: what's the security schedule for today? My company Mac is arriving later but I might need to hop on my personal laptop for a couple hours. Also how do personal device exceptions work — do I need to wait for MDM before doing any work?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Diego :tada: TL;DR — please enroll the company Mac in Jamf, make sure FileVault is enabled, and complete the security training + phishing sim within the onboarding window. Personal devices: we prefer you not use them for storing company data; web-only access via SSO is allowed temporarily. If you need VPN or local repo access we can grant a time-limited exception after a BYOD waiver is signed. Badge pickup is ~2pm today. I'll DM the waiver + links. <https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/security>
Diego Santos: Thanks! Can you DM the waiver? Also is there a quick command to check FileVault on mac? Mac is Big Sur.
Sam (Security): Congrats and welcome. To check FileVault: open Terminal and run `fdesetup status` — it should say "FileVault is On". Jamf enrollment normally happens in Setup Assistant. If it doesn't, try `sudo jamf enroll -prompt` (you might need admin). For personal devices: no company data should be synced locally; we block downloads and disallow backups to personal cloud. If you need local dev access, request a loaner.
Diego Santos: Got it, thanks. Any ETA on VPN? I need to pull private repos for a quick setup.
Maya (People Ops): VPN is usually provisioned within 1–2 hours after SSO + MFA are confirmed. Double-check Okta sign-in works. Once you confirm the Mac serial or say you're using personal, I'll trigger badge + VPN.
Diego Santos: Serial is C02ABC1234JH. I tried Okta but stuck on the SMS step.
Maya (People Ops): I'll trigger VPN now. For Okta SMS fallback try using an authenticator app (Authy/Google Authenticator) — we prefer that. I'll DM steps; Sam, tagging you in case SMS needs an override.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Redwood Security Essentials" — due in 48h. PhishSim scheduled for next Monday; new joiners are auto-exempt for their first 7 days.
Sam (Security): FYI — phishsim exclusion for first week is automatic. After that you'll be in the normal rotation. If you ever get a suspicious email before then, forward it to security@redwood.com and we'll triage.
Diego Santos: Awesome, I'll enroll the Mac when it arrives and ping here when I'm done.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect — welcome aboard again :tada: ping us if anything blocks you (DM preferred for serials/waiver).
